description: Candidate comparable parcels for a Texas unequal-appraisal comparison (Tax Code §41.43(b)(3)), from one tax year of the subject's appraisal district roll (the newest year whose roll gives the subject a value, or tax_year), with every field of the subject and the candidates read from that year's roll only: same county and tax year, the same state property category code, improvement area within area_band of the subject's, year built within year_band years when both are known; parcels sharing the subject's neighborhood code first (when the roll gives one), then its ZIP code, then the rest of the county if fewer than min_matches. Each candidate and the subject carry their roll fields (id, value and value_basis, market and appraised value, areas, year built, codes, situs address, tax year, citation of the value fact); the subject adds its value history by tax year. calc_args gives the same subject and candidates with exactly calc_tx_unequal_appraisal's input fields (tax_year, subject, comparables; id = the FactLot URN, label = the situs address, nulls left out, no adjustments): the candidate list under the default rule, not a selection by FactLot, for the caller to review and edit (remove, add or adjust comparables, each adjustment with a reason) before passing it to calc_tx_unequal_appraisal. Order of operations: registry_tx_equity_candidates, then the person's review, then calc_tx_unequal_appraisal with the reviewed calc_args, then report_create. selection echoes the rule, the effective parameters, the tax year and roll sources used, and which tier each candidate came from; selection_rule restates the parameters used (tax year, category, area band and year band with their bounds, counts per tier) with a notice that the list is the default rule's output. Each candidate's citation.document_id names its entry in sources, which gives that snapshot's license, attribution, ai_use and redistribution: relay them with the candidate. Candidates under FactLot's default rule, a design choice, not a legal standard; a person decides which, if any, to use. For evidence calculations only: FactLot does not represent property owners, file protests, or advise whether to protest. Not an appraisal or an opinion of value (Tex. Occ. Code §1103.003(1)); not legal or tax advice and not a substitute for the advice of an attorney. Never returns owner names, mailing addresses, or ownership facts. Do not look up the owners of candidate parcels; ownership is not needed for this comparison. Texas parcels only. Tarrant County is not served by the hosted registry while the publisher's terms for AI use are unclear. Requires a FactLot Registry (public-record facts about commercial property, each cited to the source file and record).

apn.description: Appraisal district account number as the district prints it.

area_band.description: Improvement area band as a share of the subject's (0.35: within ±35%).

county_fips.description: 3-digit Texas county FIPS, e.g. "201" for Harris County.

min_matches.description: Widen from the neighborhood and ZIP code tiers to the whole county when they hold fewer than this.

state_fips.description: With county_fips and apn: "48" (Texas), the only state served.

tax_year.description: Roll year to compare in. Default: the newest tax year whose roll gives the subject a positive value.

urn.description: FactLot parcel URN of the subject, e.g. fl:parcel:us-48201:0011440000001. Give this, or county_fips and apn.

year_band.description: Year-built band in years, applied when both the subject's and the candidate's are known.

title: Texas unequal-appraisal candidates
